evals.prompt: Merge PRs #28 and #29 in that order. Both are green, but rebase the remaining branch after the first merge and use normal merge commits.
evals.expected_output: Checks both heads, merges #28 normally, rebases and pushes #29 on the new base, waits for its checks, then merges #29 normally.

evals.prompt: Can you merge these two PRs? One has a new unresolved HIGH security finding and the other is green.
evals.expected_output: Does not merge past the unresolved HIGH finding; reports it and asks to fix or explicitly decide how to handle it before continuing the sequence.

evals.prompt: Rebase all three requested branches on main before the first merge, then merge each normally and keep the others current after every merge.
evals.expected_output: Rebases all requested branches before the first merge, uses normal merge commits, and rebases/checks all remaining branches after each merge.
